items.question: What is white label SEO?

nodes.value: White-label SEO is a service that allows agencies to offer SEO services to their clients under their own brand, without needing to perform the work in-house. By partnering with a white-label SEO company, agencies can deliver professional SEO strategies, link building, and technical SEO support while an external provider does the actual SEO work. This enables agencies to focus on client management and growth without needing to expand internal SEO teams.

items.question: What are the white label SEO services?

nodes.value: White label SEO services include a full range of SEO activities, from keyword research and on-page optimization to off-page strategies like link building. These services are performed by a third-party SEO provider (Heroic Rankings) but delivered under your brand. They allow agencies to offer their clients expert SEO solutions without hiring additional staff. Some of the services offered under white-label SEO include:

• Keyword research

  • Website SEO audits

  • Content optimization

  • Link building

  • Local SEO strategies

items.question: How does white label link building work?

nodes.value: White label link building services are designed to increase the authority and visibility of a client's website by obtaining high-quality backlinks from reputable sources. This helps targeted keywords increase in Google Search; therefore, the organic traffic will also increase. A white-label SEO agency handles the entire link-building process and reports on behalf of your agency, ensuring that your client’s site earns valuable links that improve search rankings. The process typically involves content outreach, guest blogging, and securing placements on relevant websites, all under your brand.

items.question: How can agencies benefit from white-label SEO services?

nodes.value: Agencies that partner with a white-label SEO company can offer SEO services without needing in-house expertise. Key benefits include:

• Expanding your service offerings without additional overhead

  • Improving client retention by offering full SEO service

  • Increasing revenue through SEO reselling and upselling opportunities

  • Delivering expert-level SEO services without the cost of hiring a full team

items.question: How does our white-label SEO program work?

nodes.value: Our white-label SEO program is designed to integrate with your agency’s workflow seamlessly. When you partner with us, we handle all of the behind-the-scenes SEO work while you manage the client relationship. Here's how it works:

• Account Management: We take care of all SEO tasks, including keyword research,
    on-page optimization, and link building.

  • Client Reports: We provide detailed reports on your clients’ SEO performance, which
    you can share with them under your branding.

  • Dedicated Support: You will have access to a dedicated project coordinator to ensure
    smooth communication and project execution.

  • This allows your agency to appear as an SEO expert while we handle the heavy
    lifting.

items.question: What is a white-label SEO reseller program?

nodes.value: A white-label SEO reseller program allows agencies to offer SEO services to their clients without performing the actual work themselves. As a reseller, you partner with a white-label SEO agency (Heroic Rankings) that performs the SEO services while you maintain the client relationship. This model enables you to scale your agency quickly and efficiently. You set the pricing for your clients, and we handle the service delivery, ensuring high-quality SEO and ROI outcomes.

items.question: How do we handle client communications in our white-label SEO partnership?

nodes.value: In a white llabel SEO partnership, client communication is key to ensuring smooth operations. Depending on your preferences, we can either remain behind the scenes or handle client-facing communication on your behalf. Here’s what we offer:

• Direct client reporting: We provide SEO reports you can send directly to your clients under your brand.

  • Transparency and support: Our team will keep you updated on campaign progress, ensuring you have all the information needed to communicate effectively with your clients.

items.question: What are the partnership options for white-label SEO services?

nodes.value: We offer two main partnership models for our white-label SEO services:

• Referral Program: Refer clients to us and earn commissions based on their total budget. This is ideal if you prefer to focus on client acquisition and want us to manage the SEO work directly.

  • White Labeling Services: We deliver all SEO services under your brand, allowing you to resell them to your clients at your desired price. This model provides full control over client relationships, pricing, and branding, making it a great fit for agencies looking to expand their service offerings without additional overhead.

en.title: Affinda

seo.title: Affinda SEO Case Study | Boosting "Resume Parser" Rankings
seo.description: Discover how Heroic Rankings helped Affinda dominate search results for "resume parser" with a strategic link-building campaign that improved rankings and organic visibility.

en.service_featured_title: Boosted organic search traffic by 300% and improved lead generation by 120% in 6 months.

nodes.value: Our targeted SEO strategy focused on content optimization, keyword research, and technical improvements led to substantial increases in organic search traffic and lead generation for Affinda.

en.description: Affinda is a leading provider of AI-powered document parsing and data extraction solutions. Their advanced technology enables businesses to automate the extraction of critical data from various documents, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. The company's flagship product, the resume parser, helps organizations streamline their recruitment processes by accurately extracting information from resumes.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to achieve top rankings for the keyword "resume parser" on Google to increase visibility and attract more customers.
Affinda faced strong competition from established players in the document parsing industry, making it difficult to secure top rankings.
The market for resume parsers is highly competitive, with numerous companies vying for the same keywords.
Affinda needed an effective SEO strategy that could deliver results within a limited budget.
To overcome these challenges, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Comprehensive SEO Audit
Conducted a thorough audit of Affinda's website to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, and backlink opportunities.

2. Keyword Optimization
Focused on optimizing on-page elements, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and content, for the keyword "resume parser".

3. High-Quality Content Creation
Developed in-depth, high-quality content around the keyword "resume parser" to establish Affinda as an authority in the field.

4. Link Building
Implemented a targeted link-building campaign to acquire high-quality backlinks from relevant, authoritative websites in the AI, technology, and recruitment industries.
5. Key Link Building Postulates

• Publish content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit focused on AI, technology, and recruitment.

  • Ensure publications are on websites with at least two of three criteria: Domain Rating (DR) 50+, Organic Traffic 1000+ with relevant traffic, and reputable TLDs.

  • Maintain a consistent link velocity to match the growth of competitors.

  • Keep all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: With a clear strategy in place, the execution involved:

nodes.value: Enhanced existing content and created new content targeting the keyword "resume parser."
Conducted targeted outreach to secure backlinks from high-authority sites, leveraging relationships with industry influencers and publications.
Fixed identified technical issues, such as site speed, mobile usability, and structured data, to improve overall site performance and search engine visibility.

en.results_description: The combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: Achieved the top position on Google for the keyword "resume parser," surpassing established competitors. This success was validated by the Ahrefs data showing Affinda ranking #1.
Substantial increase in organic traffic, from approximately 11,000 visitors to 28,000 visitors, representing a 2.5x growth.
Increased the number of high-quality referring domains significantly over the campaign period - from 39 referring domains in March 2023 to 142 in July 2023.
Maintained high-quality backlinks, which remained active and continued to provide SEO benefits. We built high-quality links from reputable sites, including Upwork, Entrepreneur, and HubSpot.
Achieved significant growth in Domain Rating from 39 to 48 indicating improved site authority and visibility.

conclusion_content.title: All external links built by our team remain active, ensuring that our clients continue to benefit from their investments.

nodes.value: This project exemplifies how precise, strategic actions and full collaboration between the client’s team and our in-house experts can achieve outstanding results, even without the initially anticipated budget, by adhering to best practices rather than outspending the competition.

By following this structured approach, Affinda successfully achieved top rankings for the critical keyword "resume parser," demonstrating the effectiveness of strategic link-building and SEO optimization.

en.title: My Baskets

seo.title: My Baskets SEO Success | How Link Building Increased Traffic
seo.description: Learn how Heroic Rankings elevated My Baskets' organic traffic through strategic outreach and high-authority backlinks, strengthening their position in the online gift industry.

en.service_featured_title: Increased organic traffic by 200% and sales by 150% in 12 months.

nodes.value: By implementing a comprehensive SEO strategy including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content marketing, we helped My Baskets achieve significant growth in organic traffic and sales.

en.description: My Baskets is a leading Canadian online retailer specializing in luxury gift baskets for various occasions. The website offers a wide range of themed baskets, including gourmet food, wine, baby gifts, and corporate gifts, ensuring a premium gifting experience for every customer.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to regain top rankings for major keywords like "gift baskets Toronto," "gift baskets Canada," and "gourmet gift baskets Canada," after noticing a significant drop in positions due to increased competition.
My Baskets had stable positions at 2 and 3 for major keywords but dropped below position 20 by spring 2023.
Competitors aggressively built new links, and previous link-building efforts were ineffective due to poor quality and relevance.
The budget limited the ability to match competitors' link output, necessitating a strategic approach.
To address these challenges within the budget constraints, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Anchor Text Audit and Optimization
Conducted a thorough audit of internal and external anchor text portfolios to align with targeted anchor text distribution for the homepage and internal collection pages.

• Important Note
    Ensuring the proper distribution of anchor text is crucial for achieving optimal SEO results to supplement low budget off site SEO campaigns.
       a. For the homepage, the target distribution was approximately 5% exact match anchors, 10% partial match and related anchors, and 85% branded and generic anchors,
       b. For internal collection pages, the target was 10% exact match anchors, 50% partial match and related anchors, and 40% branded and generic anchors,

2. Internal and External Link Building
Combined internal and external link-building efforts to achieve the desired anchor text ratio.

3. Topically Relevant Publications
Focused on publishing content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit in lifestyle, parenting, and relationships.

4. Quality Standards
Ensured publications were on websites with a Domain Rating of 50+, organic traffic of 1000+ with Canadian traffic in the top three, and preferably a .CA ccTLD.

5. Link Velocity Management
Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

6. Content Tweaks for Internal Links
Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

7. Content Tweaks for External Links
Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

8. Long-Term External Links
Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: Due to budget limitations, the team focused on:

nodes.value: Utilized Screaming Frog, Ahrefs anchor text report, and in- house Python scripts to audit and flag anchor types, revealing over optimization with 35% exact match anchors.
Created a dynamic spreadsheet with array formulas to track anchor text distribution, internal link opportunities and their implementation progress.
The client's in-house team implemented internal links following the strategy, syncing efforts with our team using the spreadsheet.
Built five high-quality backlinks per month while the client's team added up to 30 internal links to maintain the ratio.
We implemented our own Python scripts to run automated health checks for each link built on a weekly basis in order to ensure it’s longevity for over 11 months.

en.results_description: Despite competitors' higher link output, the combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 2 by October 2023, surpassing bloomex.ca and baskits.com.
From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, outranking bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.
From fluctuating and disappearing from the top 20 in summer 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, competing strongly with bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.

results_cards.title: Googlebot in refresh mode visits have become more frequent and stable

Due to external link daisy chaining we’ve managed to keep new backlink indexation to above 80% within its first month of publishing, whereas it’s a common industry standard for it to be ~60% within the first three months of publishing

Due to automated backlink health checks with our internal Python scripts, we’ve never lost a single link for more than 48 hours keeping it within the index at all times. Our total link loss for this client was less than 0.5% within 11 months, whereas industry standard can be anywhere between 35%-60% within first six month of their publication.

nodes.value: Anchor text distribution optimization played a crucial role when external link building was limited.
By maintaining quality standards and consistent link velocity growth, we improved the referring domain average DR distribution, keeping an edge over competitors.

conclusion_content.title: By following this structured approach, My Baskets successfully regained top positions for critical keywords, demonstrating the effectiveness of strategic link- building and anchor text optimization.

DesignRush had a strong in-house SEO team covering strategy, content, and development but relied heavily on PRs and reciprocal backlinks, which were of lower quality and less effective.
Reciprocal links, often from lower-quality sites, had limited SEO impact. The competition, particularly Clutch.co, had a significantly larger volume of high-quality backlinks.
Initial link-building efforts by external agencies couldn't scale due to high costs and inconsistent quality.
To overcome these challenges, the following strategies were implemented:
1. Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Quality Guidelines
Established clear SOPs and quality guidelines for link building.
2. Recruitment Support
Assisted in the recruitment and hiring process for new link builders.
3. Interdepartmental Sync
Aligned work, goals, and KPIs with the SEO and content departments.
4. Reporting
Developed reporting structures for shareholders, the head of marketing, and finance departments.

1. Publish only on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit focused on web design, web development, marketing, business, and finance.

  2. Publish only on websites that meet at least two of three criteria: Domain Rating (DR) 50+, Organic Traffic 1000+ with US traffic in the top three, and gTLDs or ccTLDs of English-speaking countries.

What can you do today to help your business grow? How can you stay competitive? Can you improve your processes and efficiency? If you are asking yourself these questions it’s time to consider custom business software. A solution made only for you and with you in mind.

Sounds great, but is it really worth it? Data shows that by next year, the custom software development industry will generate $507.2 billion in revenue. This means custom software development is on the rise.

If this number is not enough to convince you, we have prepared 10 key benefits of custom software that you can’t afford to miss. Let’s start!
What is Custom Business Software?

Custom business software is a customized software solution built for a specific business. It is developed to address unique requests and demands that are uncommon and connected to a single business, niche, or industry.

Unlike most generic solutions, custom solutions are not a one-size-fits-all kind of product. This means that these tailored software solutions are built to fit a current system and business processes that need improving. Because of their personalized approach, custom business software solutions are not only what the business needs but also what it can grow with.

They work great for small businesses as well as enterprise-level companies so your business size or business goals won’t be in the way. What makes them so great is that they are easy to advertise and package as products for other similar businesses. To fully realize your project’s potential, partnering with a reliable custom software development company is essential like “brigit.dev”.
Examples of Custom Software Solutions

• Docebo: E-learning platform for businesses

  • TraceLink: Supply chain management for pharmaceuticals

  • Kareo: Medical practice management software

  • PastPerfect: Museum management software

  • Envirosuite: Environmental monitoring software
Custom Business Software vs Off-the-Shelf Software

Custom business software and off-the-shelf solutions are different at their core. Custom software is designed for a particular business, while off-the-shelf solutions are intended for a broad range of users. While your business can benefit from both, only custom software solutions can help your business grow. Custom software

Here are the differences that show why:

1. Custom software

    • personalized approach

    • adaptable

    • not available to everyone

    • easy to scale and add new features

  2. Off-the-shelf software

    • built for a mass audience

    • can't be adapted or changed

    • immediately available

    • little or no room for scalability
To show you how these differences translate into real benefits, here's a list of key advantages custom software development can bring you.
10 Key Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth
1. Personalization for your unique needs

Custom software is designed to fit your specific needs. It addresses your unique processes and workflows. It also makes sure that the software works just the way you need it to. This means you get features that directly support your business and improve efficiency and effective use.
2. Higher return on investment

Custom software provides a higher return on investment over time. Because it’s custom-built according to you it can save money in the long run. It helps avoid extra costs associated with adapting off-the-shelf solutions to fit your business.

Additionally, it improves your work and speeds up your progress. It also makes you one step ahead of everyone on the market, because you need very detailed and specific industry expertise to make it. This makes you an industry leader and you can profit from this knowledge.
3. Competitive advantage

Custom software gives you a competitive edge because it keeps you ahead of the game. Your competition probably isn’t investing in solutions like these. They don’t have the time, money, or the expertise to do it. Everyone wants a quick solution. This helps you become a leading name. You can then profit from this down the line and sell your solution to others. It will be easier to market and position yourself as an authority on this matter.
4. Easier scalability

Custom software can grow with your business. As your needs change or expand, the software can be adjusted to handle new challenges. This makes it easier to scale your operations without having to switch to a different system. This is one of the biggest benefits.
5. Increased security

Custom software can provide better security because it is built specifically for your business. It can for example include advanced security features tailored to your unique requirements. This helps protect your sensitive data from potential threats and breaches. With custom solutions security is guaranteed.
6. Selling and marketing potential

Custom software boosts your selling and marketing potential by offering a unique solution to specific market needs. This makes your product stand out and allows you to market it as a specialized tool with features not found in generic software. This easily sets you apart from competitors. It also gives you an even bigger return on the investment down the road.
7. Faster processes

With custom software, you can speed up your business processes. The software is made to match your specific workflow and help with performance optimization. It eliminates unnecessary steps and reduces time spent on tasks. This means your team can work more quickly and productively. Ultimately it leads to faster completion of projects and services.
8. Reliable support and maintenance

Custom software usually comes with reliable support and maintenance. Since the software is built specifically for your business, you can work closely with the development team to address any issues or updates. This ensures that the software remains up-to-date and functions smoothly. It also minimizes downtime and disruptions.
9. Seamless integration

Custom software can be easily integrated with your existing systems, including legacy systems, to improve overall efficiency. It is designed to work seamlessly with other tools and applications you use to reduce compatibility issues. Easy integration doesn’t affect your workflow and avoids the complications of using incompatible software.
10. Longevity

Custom software can have a longer lifespan compared to off-the-shelf solutions. It can be updated and modified as your business grows and changes, extending its usefulness. This long-term adaptability means you won’t need to replace the software very often. It saves time and money in the long run.
Main Disadvantages of Custom Software Development You Should Consider

Custom solutions come with many benefits that most definitely outweigh the possible drawbacks. However, it’s important to know these three disadvantages to prepare and use the full potential of custom software development.
1. Time to deliver

en.value:
Custom software development often takes longer to make compared to ready-made solutions. Because the software is built specifically for your needs, the process involves detailed planning, design, and multiple stages of development.

Each phase requires a lot of attention to make sure that the software meets all requirements. This extended development period can seem long and tiring. But you must be prepared to wait and know that in the end, your business will benefit greatly from it.

Also, choosing the right custom software development partner can make the development process quicker and better.
2. Onboarding difficulties

en.value:
Even though these solutions are custom-made, some struggle to adapt to them. Unlike off-the-shelf solutions, custom software may have a longer adjustment period.

You may need specialized training to learn how to use it. This is especially true if you are used to general solutions. It might be hard to switch or believe that a single solution can change so much. It’s often all in the mindset.
3. Initial costs

image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401fb11ebcf9aac6941d07/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 04.png

en.value:
We don’t want to scare you, but we won’t hide this fact from you. The initial costs of custom software development can be quite high. Building software from scratch involves a lot of expenses for design, development, and testing. We know that this might be a barrier for many. Although the price is not always that high.

Custom software development for small businesses is a lot smaller than for custom enterprise software development. Also, it’s important to note that the long-term benefits outweigh the initial costs and bring a high return on investment.
The Bottom Line

Custom software development comes with many advantages. While the initial investment and longer development time might seem challenging, the benefits outweigh these concerns in the long run.

It is a strategic investment that brings business growth. By focusing on your specific needs, it contributes to the long-term success of your business. So if you want to stay relevant and grow your business in 2026 custom software development is necessary.

en.service_featured_title: Increased organic traffic by 200% and sales by 150% in 12 months.

nodes.value: By implementing a comprehensive SEO strategy including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content marketing, we helped My Baskets achieve significant growth in organic traffic and sales.

en.description: My Baskets is a leading Canadian online retailer specializing in luxury gift baskets for various occasions. The website offers a wide range of themed baskets, including gourmet food, wine, baby gifts, and corporate gifts, ensuring a premium gifting experience for every customer.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to regain top rankings for major keywords like "gift baskets Toronto," "gift baskets Canada," and "gourmet gift baskets Canada," after noticing a significant drop in positions due to increased competition.
My Baskets had stable positions at 2 and 3 for major keywords but dropped below position 20 by spring 2023.
Competitors aggressively built new links, and previous link-building efforts were ineffective due to poor quality and relevance.
The budget limited the ability to match competitors' link output, necessitating a strategic approach.
To address these challenges within the budget constraints, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Anchor Text Audit and Optimization
Conducted a thorough audit of internal and external anchor text portfolios to align with targeted anchor text distribution for the homepage and internal collection pages.

• Important Note
    Ensuring the proper distribution of anchor text is crucial for achieving optimal SEO results to supplement low budget off site SEO campaigns.
       a. For the homepage, the target distribution was approximately 5% exact match anchors, 10% partial match and related anchors, and 85% branded and generic anchors,
       b. For internal collection pages, the target was 10% exact match anchors, 50% partial match and related anchors, and 40% branded and generic anchors,

2. Internal and External Link Building
Combined internal and external link-building efforts to achieve the desired anchor text ratio.

3. Topically Relevant Publications
Focused on publishing content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit in lifestyle, parenting, and relationships.

4. Quality Standards
Ensured publications were on websites with a Domain Rating of 50+, organic traffic of 1000+ with Canadian traffic in the top three, and preferably a .CA ccTLD.

5. Link Velocity Management
Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

6. Content Tweaks for Internal Links
Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

7. Content Tweaks for External Links
Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

8. Long-Term External Links
Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: Due to budget limitations, the team focused on:

nodes.value: Utilized Screaming Frog, Ahrefs anchor text report, and in- house Python scripts to audit and flag anchor types, revealing over optimization with 35% exact match anchors.
Created a dynamic spreadsheet with array formulas to track anchor text distribution, internal link opportunities and their implementation progress.
The client's in-house team implemented internal links following the strategy, syncing efforts with our team using the spreadsheet.
Built five high-quality backlinks per month while the client's team added up to 30 internal links to maintain the ratio.
We implemented our own Python scripts to run automated health checks for each link built on a weekly basis in order to ensure it’s longevity for over 11 months.

en.results_description: Despite competitors' higher link output, the combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 2 by October 2023, surpassing bloomex.ca and baskits.com.
From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, outranking bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.
From fluctuating and disappearing from the top 20 in summer 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, competing strongly with bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.

results_cards.title: Googlebot in refresh mode visits have become more frequent and stable

Due to external link daisy chaining we’ve managed to keep new backlink indexation to above 80% within its first month of publishing, whereas it’s a common industry standard for it to be ~60% within the first three months of publishing

Due to automated backlink health checks with our internal Python scripts, we’ve never lost a single link for more than 48 hours keeping it within the index at all times. Our total link loss for this client was less than 0.5% within 11 months, whereas industry standard can be anywhere between 35%-60% within first six month of their publication.

nodes.value: Anchor text distribution optimization played a crucial role when external link building was limited.
By maintaining quality standards and consistent link velocity growth, we improved the referring domain average DR distribution, keeping an edge over competitors.

nodes.value: All external links built by our team remain active, ensuring that our clients continue to benefit from their investments.

This project exemplifies how precise, strategic actions and full collaboration between the client’s team and our in-house experts can achieve outstanding results, even without the initially anticipated budget, by adhering to best practices rather than outspending the competition.

Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

Custom software can grow with your business. As your needs change or expand, the software can be adjusted to handle new challenges. This makes it easier to scale your operations without having to switch to a different system. This is one of the biggest benefits.
5. Increased security

Custom software can provide better security because it is built specifically for your business. It can for example include advanced security features tailored to your unique requirements. This helps protect your sensitive data from potential threats and breaches. With custom solutions security is guaranteed.
6. Selling and marketing potential

Custom software boosts your selling and marketing potential by offering a unique solution to specific market needs. This makes your product stand out and allows you to market it as a specialized tool with features not found in generic software. This easily sets you apart from competitors. It also gives you an even bigger return on the investment down the road.
7. Faster processes

With custom software, you can speed up your business processes. The software is made to match your specific workflow and help with performance optimization. It eliminates unnecessary steps and reduces time spent on tasks. This means your team can work more quickly and productively. Ultimately it leads to faster completion of projects and services.
8. Reliable support and maintenance

Custom software usually comes with reliable support and maintenance. Since the software is built specifically for your business, you can work closely with the development team to address any issues or updates. This ensures that the software remains up-to-date and functions smoothly. It also minimizes downtime and disruptions.
9. Seamless integration

Custom software can be easily integrated with your existing systems, including legacy systems, to improve overall efficiency. It is designed to work seamlessly with other tools and applications you use to reduce compatibility issues. Easy integration doesn’t affect your workflow and avoids the complications of using incompatible software.
10. Longevity

Custom software can have a longer lifespan compared to off-the-shelf solutions. It can be updated and modified as your business grows and changes, extending its usefulness. This long-term adaptability means you won’t need to replace the software very often. It saves time and money in the long run.
Main Disadvantages of Custom Software Development You Should Consider

Custom solutions come with many benefits that most definitely outweigh the possible drawbacks. However, it’s important to know these three disadvantages to prepare and use the full potential of custom software development.
1. Time to deliver

Custom software development often takes longer to make compared to ready-made solutions. Because the software is built specifically for your needs, the process involves detailed planning, design, and multiple stages of development.

Each phase requires a lot of attention to make sure that the software meets all requirements. This extended development period can seem long and tiring. But you must be prepared to wait and know that in the end, your business will benefit greatly from it.

2. Onboarding difficulties

3. Initial costs

Custom software development for small businesses is a lot smaller than for custom enterprise software development. Also, it’s important to note that the long-term benefits outweigh the initial costs and bring a high return on investment.
The Bottom Line

Custom software development comes with many advantages. While the initial investment and longer development time might seem challenging, the benefits outweigh these concerns in the long run.

It is a strategic investment that brings business growth. By focusing on your specific needs, it contributes to the long-term success of your business. So if you want to stay relevant and grow your business in 2026 custom software development is necessary.

• Important Note
    Ensuring the proper distribution of anchor text is crucial for achieving optimal SEO results to supplement low budget off site SEO campaigns.
       a. For the homepage, the target distribution was approximately 5% exact match anchors, 10% partial match and related anchors, and 85% branded and generic anchors,
       b. For internal collection pages, the target was 10% exact match anchors, 50% partial match and related anchors, and 40% branded and generic anchors,

2. Internal and External Link Building
Combined internal and external link-building efforts to achieve the desired anchor text ratio.

3. Topically Relevant Publications
Focused on publishing content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit in lifestyle, parenting, and relationships.

4. Quality Standards
Ensured publications were on websites with a Domain Rating of 50+, organic traffic of 1000+ with Canadian traffic in the top three, and preferably a .CA ccTLD.

5. Link Velocity Management
Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

6. Content Tweaks for Internal Links
Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

7. Content Tweaks for External Links
Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

8. Long-Term External Links
Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.value: SEO marketing can mean a number of things. Whenever you’re taking steps to increase your SEO rank, you can argue that you’re engaging in some form of SEO marketing. Still, there are various SEO marketing practices, some of which are more efficient than others.
Now, before we move any further, we must get one thing out of the way – we won’t give you a basic course with points like:

• Do your keyword research better.

  • Improve the quality of your content.

  • Arm yourself with patience.

Every guide has already covered this (more than once), and a person googling “how to do SEO yourself” has already seen it. It’s quite intuitive, and it’s the go-to solution even if you don’t have previous experience with SEO (or even know what SEO is). It makes sense that you’ll get more traffic if your content is better, right?
Instead, we’ll focus on some underused SEO practices, especially those that could be pretty useful in 2026.
Analyze the first page of Google results

image.name: Guide to B2B Seo Solutions - Image 05.png

en.value: If your main objective is to rank for specific keywords, you’re really aiming to get to the first page of SERPs. When doing your keyword research, you’ll see the keywords with the largest volume, but you’ll often skip these because they’re too competitive.
Instead, why not do some research and analysis on them and try to figure out how to do SEO by mimicking the success of others?

In other words, imagine an ideal world where you could pick a keyword and get to the No.1 spot on Google search, regardless of who else is competing for it. Well, the person who ranks first actually did just that. Why not check out their page and try to figure out how they did it?
What kind of content are they featuring? What’s their site architecture and metadata like?
Remember, you’re trying to mimic their SEO success, not “steal” the spot for that particular keyword from them.

Just bear in mind that it’s not all SEO. Sometimes, they’ll have a hefty war chest and spend a fortune on ads (this is usually the case for top results in some of the most saturated niches). This leaves you to try and figure out which of these is organic SEO and what is sponsored content (PPC, social media advertising, etc.).
Optimize for search intent

image.name: Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 02.png
image.src: /people/Nikola/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 02.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68416a371ebcf9aac6941dac/bin2/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 02.png

en.value: The majority of digital marketers get lost in trying to interpret what Google does instead of asking a simple question – what does Google want? The simplest answer is that Google wants to develop an algorithm that is so powerful that it will understand user intent, even when users have trouble verbalizing their thoughts. With the help of NLP technology, they’re closer to this than ever.

So, what is the most important thing to consider when optimizing a search engine marketing campaign? The short answer is understanding your customers’ intent and serving them what they’re looking for, not just what they’re typing into the search box.
One of the best ways to do this is to start by asking what they really want to know.

Imagine a person looking for a lemonade recipe. How would they start? They’ll look up either “how to make lemonade?” or “lemonade recipes.” The title of the post, therefore, needs to look like it actually contains all the answers that they’re looking for.
So, what’s the practice you’d want to use for turning marketing insights into action?
The simplest answer to this question is – intuitive thinking.

Just keep in mind that you aren’t always an average internet user or a perfect example of your target audience. You have detailed SEO knowledge and a deep insight into how the algorithms and search engines work. This affects your thought process even if you don’t realize it.
Instead, you need to conduct a survey or get an outsider’s insight. Even a small study or survey can help you understand this a lot better.
Focus on click-less interactions

image.name: Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 03.png
image.src: /people/Nikola/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 03.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68416a981ebcf9aac6941dae/bin2/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 03.png

en.value: Becoming a featured snippet is incredibly important, especially with so many Google searches ending without anyone actually clicking on a link. Some of the latest surveys talk about as much as 50.3% of all searches.
This is huge, and it’s a market you need to capitalize on.

You see, this is one of the biggest tricks for building strategies for your digital marketing. For one to eventually become a proper customer, they must first interact with your brand. This is a part of your long-term growth strategy. Even if they don’t click on the link, this still counts as an interaction. The big problem with this is that there’s no traffic increase with these clickless interactions, and traffic is a huge SEO metric.
In other words, qualifying for Google snippet is a horribly underrated aspect of SEO marketing that you cannot afford to ignore anymore.

First of all, you need to understand that, contrary to popular belief, paragraphs are the most common featured snippet type. They are roughly 70% of all snippets, with lists (the thing you would assume goes first) having only 19.1% of this market.

You can’t upload a paragraph hoping it will rank. It needs to be the right format. Everyone knows that answering a “How to” question is the easy way to get there, but what else can you do? Posts that are 1100+ words long have well-structured data, proper tags (H1, H2, H3, etc.), and images and are far more likely to qualify.
Featured snippets also vary from one industry to another. Industries that are featured the most often are:

• Travel

  • Computer and electronics

  • Art and entertainment

  • Science

By doing this right, you’ll get a better understanding of audience behavior, higher brand authority (a huge SEO metric), and (indirectly) even a higher CTR. You see, there are different types of SEO, and they all benefit from advanced insights.
Find and fix technical issues

image.name: Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 04.png
image.src: /people/Nikola/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 04.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68416ab71ebcf9aac6941daf/bin2/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 04.png

en.value: In order to run a successful SEO campaign, you need the right website strategy. Chances are that you already have a website, but it’s riddled with technical issues that are hampering your SEO without you even realizing it.
Some of these are:

• Site architecture

  • URL structure

  • JavaScript

  • XML sitemaps
Sometimes, however, the problem will be too obvious and really hard to miss.

For instance, your content may be too thin. Many of your blog posts are old, and they may not generate any traffic. They’re probably a lot smaller, seeing as how the average blog post size has increased drastically over the years. Just finding 500-600-word posts, updating them with new content, and expanding them to be at least 1100+ words will make a world of difference for your SEO.

While this sounds really preposterous, carefully go through your blog, and you might just find a duplicate blog post. This is a huge problem for your SEO marketing and something you have to either remove or replace right away.

Most importantly, you need to identify 404 pages and 301 pages and deal with them accordingly. Keep in mind that while you may have a system in place looking out for these, a missed update or two could still hide these tracks and put you in a bit of an awkward spot.

It just doesn’t hurt to check everything twice, especially since Google is not omnipotent or omniscient, and they could have just found out about a problem that’s been present for a while. One of the biggest fallacies is believing that it’s a new problem because it just appeared.
Focus on targeted SEO

image.name: Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 05.png
image.src: /people/Nikola/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 05.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68416ad51ebcf9aac6941db0/bin2/Best Practice for SEO Marketing in 2025 - Image 05.png

en.value: Another fallacy that newcomers to this field believe is that their rank can just grow in a vacuum. In reality, you need to find your realized niche and fight your best to rise in this closed (specific) ecosystem.
By trying to hit everyone, you’ll miss everyone. This is why you need to harness the power of targeted SEO.
This means exactly identifying your audience. Just think about it. Previously, we’ve talked about figuring out the intent behind the keyword. In order to do this, you need to know who’s typing.

A person looking for a tool that cuts through wood can be a carpenter or a gardener. The keywords are the same, but they use different tools. When making your campaign, what you’re actually doing is figuring out who you’re targeting and optimizing your keywords for the search of your ideal demographic. Anyone extra who falls into your net is a great bonus, but you need to know who your original audience is.

This is why it’s so tricky to engage in SEO and SMO traffic lead generation, seeing as how your audience may use specific jargon filled with amazing keywords that you’re just missing. Profiling your audience is the first thing you have to do to make a better campaign.
Using the right SEO practice is the basis for a great SEO marketing campaign

Ultimately, your choice of SEO practices makes all the difference in an SEO campaign. The bottom line is to understand that modern algorithms are way different than they were before. Knowing what they were looking for is more important than what they actually typed; they don’t have to click on the link to benefit your SEO (or even your link building), and regular checkups of your site are more important than you think.

en.description: My Baskets is a leading Canadian online retailer specializing in luxury gift baskets for various occasions. The website offers a wide range of themed baskets, including gourmet food, wine, baby gifts, and corporate gifts, ensuring a premium gifting experience for every customer.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to regain top rankings for major keywords like "gift baskets Toronto," "gift baskets Canada," and "gourmet gift baskets Canada," after noticing a significant drop in positions due to increased competition.
My Baskets had stable positions at 2 and 3 for major keywords but dropped below position 20 by spring 2023.
Competitors aggressively built new links, and previous link-building efforts were ineffective due to poor quality and relevance.
The budget limited the ability to match competitors' link output, necessitating a strategic approach.
To address these challenges within the budget constraints, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Anchor Text Audit and Optimization
Conducted a thorough audit of internal and external anchor text portfolios to align with targeted anchor text distribution for the homepage and internal collection pages.

• Important Note
    Ensuring the proper distribution of anchor text is crucial for achieving optimal SEO results to supplement low budget off site SEO campaigns.
       a. For the homepage, the target distribution was approximately 5% exact match anchors, 10% partial match and related anchors, and 85% branded and generic anchors,
       b. For internal collection pages, the target was 10% exact match anchors, 50% partial match and related anchors, and 40% branded and generic anchors,

2. Internal and External Link Building
Combined internal and external link-building efforts to achieve the desired anchor text ratio.

3. Topically Relevant Publications
Focused on publishing content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit in lifestyle, parenting, and relationships.

4. Quality Standards
Ensured publications were on websites with a Domain Rating of 50+, organic traffic of 1000+ with Canadian traffic in the top three, and preferably a .CA ccTLD.

5. Link Velocity Management
Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

6. Content Tweaks for Internal Links
Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

7. Content Tweaks for External Links
Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

8. Long-Term External Links
Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

items.question: What is local SEO?

nodes.value:
Local SEO is a strategy focused on optimizing your online presence to attract
customers in a specific geographic area. It involves techniques that target local
search engine results and enhance your visibility to nearby potential customers.

items.question: How does local SEO differ from traditional SEO?

nodes.value:
While traditional SEO aims to improve general search engine visibility, local SEO
focuses specifically on ranking well in local search results. It emphasizes locationbased keywords, Google My Business optimization, and local citations.

items.question: What is the role of Google Business Profile in local SEO?

nodes.value: Google Business Profile (GBP) is crucial for local SEO. It’s a platform where you can list your business’s information, photos, reviews, and more. Optimizing your GBP improves your local search visibility and helps customers find your business easily.

items.question: Why are local citations important?

nodes.value: Local citations are online references to your business’s NAP (Name, Address, Phone Number). Consistent citations across reputable directories validate your business’s location and enhance your local authority and search rankings.

items.question: How does location-specific keyword targeting work?

nodes.value:
Location-specific keywords include geographical terms that help your business
appear in local search results. We optimize your content with these keywords,
increasing the chances of your business being visible when people search for
services in your area.

items.question: What role do online reviews play in local SEO?

nodes.value:
Online reviews influence customer decisions. Positive reviews build trust and
credibility, while negative reviews can impact your reputation. Our reputation
management strategies help you cultivate positive feedback and address concerns constructively.

image.alt_text: picture of our team at the airport
image.name: 1.jpg

en.value: Since we’ve been building our company and brand for almost a year, we realized that one thing we haven’t done but would really love to was – visiting a conference for some international networking. So, one day in September we all talked and agreed that the Web Summit in Lisbon is literally a must-do! We jumped right into the planning mode by getting the summit tickets, looking for the perfect plane ride, and making some cool branded T-shirts and other promo stuff. Because if you want to go to a huge conference, you better dress yourself to stand out, or at least to be able to find your crew if you get lost in the vibrant sea of tech people.

We were so excited to be a part of the crowd of 70,000 people, and we started reaching out to other people who were going months before the summit. We wanted to weave a solid network before we even set foot in Lisbon.
Day 0 of the Summit

image.name: IMG_5542-edited-scaled.jpg

en.value: We’ve heard a lot about the enchanting beauty of Lisbon from some of our friends who were there before, so we set our sails with some images and a bit of expectation in our heads. But after landing there, all those expectations were so exceeded!

Day 0 of the summit was like stepping into another world because we could already feel the electric atmosphere of the summit already on the airplane. There, we bumped into many other attendees and the flight turned into a mini networking session in the sky. And the scale of the whole thing hit us when we got to the airport as part of it was transformed into a large registration hub for the summit. Everything was so impressively organized to handle loads of participants. We got our credentials very quickly – said our company name, had our tickets scanned, and voilà – we got our identification bracelets. We took our bags and headed out to our accommodation. We were all geared up for the days ahead, but first – some well deserved rest.
Day 1 of the Summit

image.name: 2.jpg

en.value: Having arrived the night before the conference, we had our good night’s sleep, and decided to ease into the following day. The weather? A sunny 20°C November day, which we used to roam around the center of Lisbon before the summit began. The start was at 5 PM so we had almost the whole day for leisure.

Day 1 of the summit is more like a warm-up day, and introduction for all the attendees where you could listen to various industry experts, sponsors, and organizers giving speeches. There’s no need to be 100% ready to network right away, no need to hit the ground running, but just hang out, soak in some talks, and enjoy a few beers outside. We were still shaking off jet lag and getting our heads around the massive crowd, so it was nice not to have to dive deep into business stuff right away. It’s good to remember that day one’s chill – definitely helps keep the overwhelm at bay.

I didn’t know this before, but day one is just the tip of the iceberg. There are pavilions and a ton of events lined up for the rest of the summit. After catching a few opening speeches, enjoying some drinks, and meeting new people, we decided to head home for the evening.
Day 2 of the Summit

image.alt_text: heroic team selfie on their way to altice arena
image.name: 3.jpg

en.value: Fully rested, we were ready to dive into the second day for the summit. It was also our first time trying out social media interviews to create fresh content and spread the word about Heroic Rankings. And let me tell you, everything was buzzing with excitement! The day before, we were seeing many summit attendees in the city thanks to their name tags. Pro tip: If you see someone with a tag, feel free to go and say hi! Chances are, they’re just as keen to chat as you are.

One of our team members is super outgoing and chatty, you could say he’s a natural at mingling. He took the initiative of breaking the ice and approaching people to talk to. That encouraged the rest of us to let loose and mingle, as well.

The crowd at the Web Summit was super diverse! There were people without their own booths who came to promote their business. Next, you had various investors walking around, scouting for cool new SaaS startups. And of course, there were the startups themselves – the Alphas, the Betas, and those still in the Growth stage – all eager to showcase their products and attract potential partners and investors. The Web Summit has got a ticket for everyone – Women in Tech, scholars, partners, investors, executives, VIPs, speakers, chairpersons, guests, and media representatives.

We spent the entire second day meeting startups at their booths in the bustling Altice Arena. Some attendees were engrossed in guest speakers’ talks, others manned their stands, and many engaged in meetings or relaxed at food and drink booths. The post-introduction day energy was evident, with everyone eager to connect with those they wanted to meet. Our strategy involved scheduled meetings, which we attended in pairs to maximize our outreach.
Day 3 of the Summit

image.name: 4.jpg

en.value: Determined to maximize our experience and being already familiar with the event’s dynamics, we rose early on the third day. It was when things really started to click for us because we felt more composed and ready to engage. This day also turned out to be remarkably productive as we made connections with a variety of potential partners. Our time in the arena was non-stop, and the only break we had was during lunch. We clocked about 15,000 steps by day’s end.

The evening brought a welcome change of pace. We were keen to continue networking in a more relaxed setting, so we planned to attend a scheduled dinner. However, our busy day and the city’s traffic had other plans, leading us to arrive late and ultimately landing us in Lisbon’s city center. Coincidentally, the Night Summit was in full swing nearby, featuring a lively karaoke night. Despite the crowds and a bit of a wait to get in, the atmosphere was really enjoyable.

A small note on the organization – the venue initially chosen struggled to accommodate the number of attendees, leading to a move to another location after a short wait. Yet, the night evolved into a memorable experience at a local nightclub, where we continued to hang out with other summit attendees. It’s worth noting that these Night Summit events often present excellent opportunities for networking, sometimes even more than the formal day events. So, a piece of advice: don’t skip these evening gatherings but try to make the most of them!
Day 4 of the Summit

image.name: 5.jpg

en.value: By the time Day 4 of the summit rolled around, we had pretty much ticked off most of our meeting goals, so this day had a more relaxed, bonus feel to it.

Some of us hit the conference ground early, while the rest of the team kept busy lining up chats with potential partners. A real standout moment was our meet-up with Analyzee, a development company from Croatia. We knew about them before the summit and were seriously impressed by both their enthusiasm and their tool’s effectiveness. Getting to know them was definitely a highlight of our time there.

Our interactions were mostly with development companies and SaaS startups, especially those in the AI field, since artificial intelligence was a big theme this year. We couldn’t catch all the speeches due to time constraints, but we’re already looking forward to next year’s summit.
After the whirlwind of these days, we chose a low-key final night, just relaxing at our place and reflecting on everything we achieved and the lively vibe of Lisbon during the summit.

There was this real sense of pride in how we, as a young company, engaged at such a prestigious tech conference. Was it worth it? Absolutely. In the calm after the conference, I had the chance to really look at what we accomplished and how we measured up. Even though it was our first big conference, our prep with promotional materials and pre-planned meetings really paid off. We put our all into it, and it showed in the potential clients we connected with, setting us up for some exciting opportunities in 2026. Plus, the summit was a great chance for our team to bond, strengthen our personal ties, and reinforce our shared goals.
Tips for the Web Summit:

image.alt_text: anastasija in front of woman in tech
image.name: 6.jpg

en.value: Be Prepared

Engage in conversations with as many people as possible months or weeks before the Web Summit. It’s crucial to schedule meetings before the conference, as remembering everyone you’ve chatted with can be a challenge during the event.
Be Relaxed

Many attendees will be eager to talk, so they’ll appreciate your initiative in reaching out. Lisbon offers countless opportunities to meet potential clients in unexpected places, so embrace spontaneity.
Promotion Material

Branded T-shirts are essential! Additionally, consider showcasing key aspects of your product or service. For instance, we displayed our link-building reports, demonstrating how we enhance business growth through effective link-building strategies.
Document Your Experience

Take plenty of pictures and film videos daily for quality content about your company/brand. Highlighting your participation in such a reputable conference can significantly boost your company’s profile.
Send Follow-up Emails
After the conference, promptly remind the people you spoke with about your conversation. A quick email can help refresh their memory about you and introduce your product or service offers.
Make Google Sheets for Prospects
Keep a well-organized document listing all the contacts you make. With the high volume of interactions at the conference, it’s easy to lose track, so this list can be an invaluable resource.
Buy Tickets Early in Promotion Packages

Take advantage of promotional offers, like getting two tickets for the price of one if you book just after the conference. Also, look out for discounts, such as reduced prices for female team members on Women’s Day.
Last Words

Reflecting on our journey at the Web Summit, I’m struck by the impact it had not just on our business, but also on our personal growth. Lisbon’s atmosphere and dynamic energy provided the perfect backdrop for an event that was as much about creating meaningful connections as it was about exploring the latest in marketing and technology. Our interactions, particularly with AI-focused startups, opened our eyes to the boundless potential of tech-driven innovation.

As we leave the Summit, we take with us not just professional contacts but also a renewed sense of purpose and a wealth of memories. This experience went beyond a typical business conference, turning into a journey full of discovery and inspiration. For those thinking about attending the Web Summit, it offers a chance for not only business growth but also for significant personal and team development.
