en.value: Navigating the challenges of selling in international markets through the web and dealing with all the various cultural and linguistic differences across every region can be overwhelming.
But, using effective and planned International SEO techniques, you can go beyond these obstacles by creating a consistent brand image worldwide.
Understanding International SEO

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SE - Image 02.png

en.value: International SEO is the strategy of optimizing a website to meet the requirements of various international audiences. International SEO requires a deeper understanding of the cultural nuances of each area, as well as the language differences, preferences of Search Engines in each country, and the general behavior of internet users within each specific country/region. By employing localized content strategies, hreflang tag management, and adapting to local search engine ranking factors, your ability to communicate effectively on a global scale will increase, while providing users around the world with an experience that meets their unique requirements.
Cultural nuances in content creation
Not only will understanding and effectively localizing cultural nuance in your content be respectful of your target markets, but it will also help to build trust and loyalty for your brand.

A successful U.S.-based campaign could easily flop internationally if cultural sensitivities are not taken into account. What resonates as funny in one culture may be offensive in another; what is effective at building a connection in one region may create an image problem in another. An international SEO company has to be skilled at navigating these complex cultural differences and nuances.
Localization goes well beyond simple translations by incorporating culturally relevant and sensitive content.

Localization strategies - Effectively creating unique content for each market while maintaining a consistent branding message requires an artist's touch. An expert in localizing content incorporates local traditions, humor, idiom, and cultural references so that you appear to be speaking directly to a global audience when marketing your brand.
Local search algorithms and SERPs

Local search algorithms represent advanced systems for the purpose of focusing on local search relevance so that consumers may locate products or services near them. Therefore, marketers are able to identify the best ways to effectively target a consumer's geographic region using these algorithms.

Additionally, because search engines personalize results to reflect each user's current geographic location, digital marketing agencies must focus on geo-targeted SEO strategies for their marketing campaigns.

In addition to geo-targeted SEO, search engines use specific ranking signals such as Google My Business (previously referred to as Google Places; now called Google Business Profile), and other forms of local citations to rank search results. An effective local search engine optimization (SEO) strategy utilizes all of these methods.

Local search results also present differently depending on the type of device or platform from which they are viewed. As a result, digital marketing agencies must create a responsive and optimized website design that is compatible with different user experiences.

In order to be competitive in global markets, companies must understand how the regional search engines of different markets prefer their search results to be presented, and that there are differences in the way algorithms operate in regions where Google does not dominate the search market. In many cases, alternative search engines have their own unique approaches to providing local search results.
Multilingual keyword research

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SE - Image 03.png

en.value: Cultural differences are critical factors that need to be considered when developing keywords that will effectively reach a specific locale.

The number of languages used throughout the European Union is vast, with 24 languages being recognized as official languages; therefore, it is critical to have an understanding of linguistics when developing a keyword campaign for a global audience.

Since search intent varies from country to country, keyword selection should also be done at a regional level. Therefore, local slang, local search habits, and local language idioms must be included in the development of your keyword strategy.
By conducting competitor research in the markets you wish to enter, you will learn about successful use of keywords that can help you engage with your target audience on a more local level.

To develop a culturally relevant and relevantly searched keyword campaign, utilize native speakers in each of the locales you wish to do business in to conduct research that provides authenticity to your research.
Technical SEO for a Global Audience

The multitude of complexities when you are reaching a global audience increases the technical aspects of SEO. It is important to be able to provide a way for search engines to crawl and index your content in multiple languages and locations. This involves using hreflang tags to help target both the language and region of your content, as well as creating a website architecture that fits each location's preference.

A successful global user experience depends on an equally successful site speed and mobile usability. A Content Delivery Network (CDN) can greatly increase international site speeds by reducing the amount of time it takes for your site to load due to latency. Technical SEO for a global audience requires accessibility and compliance with regional web standards to ensure that your company has a strong and lasting digital footprint globally.
Domain structure strategies

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SE - Image 04.png

en.value: International reach requires that an appropriate domain structure be selected. Country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs), sub-domains, and/or sub-directories can all be used to help target specific geographic locations.
Using ccTLDs signals clear geotargeting to search engines and users alike.
However, managing multiple domains can divide your branding and dilute authority.
Subdomains (like fr.domain.com) are often easier to set up and manage than ccTLDs.
Sub-directories (i.e., domain.com/fr/ ) are a good way to maintain authority across the domain; they may require additional technical resources in order to be managed properly.

You should consider your business objectives and the markets you plan to service when selecting which approach best suits your needs. Seek expert assistance from an SEO consultancy so that you will have sufficient information on which to base your decision regarding the international domain structure of your website.
hreflang tags for cross-language support

Hreflang tags are a vital component of any website with content available in multiple languages. By telling search engines which language version of a piece of content to serve to which audience, they improve the chances of users finding content written in their native language. This improves the overall experience of users worldwide and expands the global reach of your website.

If implemented properly, hreflang tags will also help you avoid the duplicate content penalty created by using the same content on multiple language versions of your website. If not properly implemented, search engines may show the wrong version of your content to an international user; this can cause significant losses in traffic and limit your ability to target demographics based on language.

Because improper implementation of this international SEO tactic can create many problems, it is very important to implement hreflang tags carefully. When you implement them properly, you need to include the language and regional information for each page on your website, regardless of whether those pages target audiences who speak British English, American English, Canadian French, or any other possible combinations of languages and regions.

In addition to needing to maintain hreflang tags, they cannot be a one-time solution. Since the content on your site will constantly evolve (adding new content, making changes, etc.), your hreflang tags must evolve as well. It is also crucial to keep up with all hreflang tags for your website, especially if you have a lot of pages or are targeting a large number of language-region combinations.

Hreflang tags are an important technical part of international SEO. If you do not implement them properly, you may create a barrier to connecting with potential customers globally and limit the success of your online marketing.
Website speed and global hosting solutions

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SE - Image 05 (1).png

en.value: Website speed plays an important role in both user experience and SEO results, especially with the world becoming smaller. Many individuals fail to consider the importance of website optimization for mobile devices. Think about an e-commerce site where all products are displayed, and when a customer/visitor clicks on a product, they have to wait 5-10 seconds for it to load. The chances of them leaving your website increase dramatically. To avoid this:

1. Choose a Content Delivery Network (CDN): Utilizing a CDN can drastically reduce latency by caching content at global edge locations.

  2. Evaluate Web Hosting Providers: Pick a hosting solution known for high uptime and servers in strategic geographical areas.

  3. Optimize for Mobile Users: Ensure your site is responsive and fast for mobile users worldwide, as they often make up the bulk of international traffic.

  4. Implement Advanced Caching: Employ caching mechanisms like object caching and full-page caching to enhance performance.

  5. Regularly Monitor Speed: Constantly monitor website speed across different locations to maintain optimal performance levels.
By using the correct tools, you can expand the global reach of your website and enhance visitor experience regardless of the visitor's geographic location.
Leveraging Localized Social Media

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SE - Image 06.png

en.value: Engaging users on social media improves the organic SEO performance of your brand by increasing the amount of content you are able to reach in order to create a community.

To attract and engage an international audience, use cultural awareness in the content you produce and speak their language. Use regional or local influencers and hashtags that are relevant to the local market in order to build more meaningful relationships with your audience.

Localizing your content strategy will enhance your ability to drive traffic from specific regions and support your regional SEO efforts by showing search engines how relevant and authoritative your content is in each geographic area.
Regional engagement tactics
Delve into cultural nuances.

It is important to understand the cultural nuances of an area in order to effectively communicate with a regional audience. While simply translating content can help you begin communicating with a new region, creating messages that resonate with local customs, traditions, and current social-political climate will increase the likelihood of your content being shared, discussed, and remembered.
Leverage local trends and events

Establish relationships with user-generated content from the area that is specific to you (local). Engaging local audiences to generate content about your products or services will promote real community activity. Not only does this add diversity to your content, but it also builds credibility and validity with your audience within your local markets.
Participate in region-specific platforms.

Modify your strategy on social platforms to meet regional needs. Regardless if you are using VK in Russia, XING in Germany/Austria/Switzerland, or Line in Japan, using the most popular social media channels in a particular region will significantly increase your brand presence and the level of engagement in each location.
Host local events or webinars.

Build a relationship with your community by participating in local events. By hosting/sponsoring events in major areas, you will develop excitement and an active local base. Hosting webinars that address topics of interest/concerns within your target market will help your company be viewed as a respected/leader in your industry among your community.
Collaborate with regional influencers.

When executed effectively, influencer marketing can be an incredible tool for developing a strong presence in regional markets. Brands partner with well-known regional influencers who have built up a level of credibility and loyalty with their followers, allowing them to connect with those followers through that credibility.
Multi-country content calendars

Creating a content calendar that covers multiple countries will require both detailed planning and a deep appreciation for the many cultural nuances that exist within different locales around the world. To develop meaningful connections with these many different cultures and geographic areas, it is necessary to understand what resonates with each culture and how you can tailor your message appropriately to be effective.

For an international SEO campaign to be successful, the content created needs to be relevant to the holidays, events, and seasonal trends of each specific country or region. Transcreation (as opposed to simple translation) is a critical component of this process as it requires the message to be rewritten so that it remains culturally sensitive and engaging. Creating culturally relevant content will help create relevance locally and enhance both user engagement and organic search ranking position.

Also, consistency in posting at all hours across all time zones is important. Scheduling programs that allow you to post in several time zones will help you maintain consistency across all of the regions your brand operates. Posting content simultaneously around the world will increase the number of people who see it and interact with it.

In addition to posting at the same time, monitoring how well your content performs in each country and using the results to adjust your content strategy is critical to being successful on social media globally. Your use of social media will be unique to each region and country, and you will need to make adjustments to your strategy based on the results you receive from each region/country.
Influencer Partnerships for Local Impact

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SE - Image 07.png

en.value: Influencers create a credible and authentic means to build trust and get noticed in targeted, local areas. When working together with area influencers, brands will be able to utilize their local knowledge and credibility to establish connections with certain demographics on a much deeper level.

By establishing a connection with the area, brands have the ability to circumvent cultural and linguistic barriers faster. Additionally, brands can use influencers as a platform to reach audiences who already meet their target profile.

Local influencers are often viewed by consumers as a peer or neighbor, rather than as a celebrity from afar. As such, endorsements from these individuals (especially if they create content that is well-suited for the area) can help foster engagement and conversion.

When choosing an influencer, take the time to consider the region's nuances so that you select an individual whose audience is aligned with your brand values and target audience. The increased accuracy of targeting the center of local consumer groups makes it easier for your message to resonate and be effective.

Develop campaigns that connect with local audiences through the use of influencers to show off products that are shown in settings which will be very recognizable for their followers. By doing this, you can bridge the gap from a global brand to local relevance, make your product appear more relatable and appealing to your potential customers.
The end result should be to become an invisible part of users' daily lives. To successfully insert your messaging into the local fabric and create engagement, influencer partnerships must be organic.
Analytics and Performance Tracking

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SE - Image 08.png

en.value: To get the most out of your international SEO, it's helpful to use analytics and performance tracking as tools for digital marketing. These tools are great ways to help you see what users do and how well your campaigns are doing in different markets. You will be able to make better decisions about where to put money or time (strategy) when you monitor the trends of your performance data.

This will allow you to see exactly how much your international SEO efforts have penetrated your target market and increased your visibility. It will also ensure that your international SEO efforts give you the largest return on investment possible as you continually adapt to changing global search patterns. As an added benefit, Google search updates occur frequently; therefore, it is good to track these updates to stay current with all the new trends.
Region-specific metrics for success

Success in search engines around the world doesn't look the same - it's complex. What works well for one area of the world (in terms of the search metrics you use) won't necessarily work as well in other areas of the world. Thus, an effective strategy for analyzing and creating an SEO strategy needs to reflect this complexity.

An example of this complexity is the differences in how people search the web in various countries. While Google dominates most of the world (and its market share is substantial), there are other countries where users have completely different ways of searching the web and using their search engines. For example, Baidu dominates the Chinese search engine space while Yandex does the same in Russia. If companies wish to develop successful SEO strategies that connect with locals, they need to understand and adapt to these diverse search behaviors and algorithms. While broad metrics may indicate overall success, they can mask the subtlety of regional success unless you break down your data by region.

Additionally, understanding and successfully optimizing for local language searches and cultural context is equally important in developing successful international SEO strategies. Translating copy isn't sufficient - you must localize the copy, which means developing the copy and keywords to fit the specific search behavior of a particular locale. Localized keyword research is key to navigating the search environment, accounting for colloquialisms, regional dialects, and all manner of regional nuances.
Competitor Analysis Across Borders

image.name: Maximize Presence With International SEO - Image 01.png

en.value: It is very important to understand how your competitor's strategies differ across different regions when creating a strong International SEO Campaign. An expert will be able to identify what your competitor is doing well and where there may be opportunities in their strategy for your brand to capitalize on.
Identifying who has the largest search presence in each of your target markets provides you with a baseline to compare to and allows you to develop a strategic plan.

Analyzing your competitors' strategies, including the types of content they produce to fit culturally, the region-specific and general keywords they rank for, and their backlinks, will provide you with the information needed to optimize and create effective SEO and link-building strategies.

Content localization encompasses more than just translation; it requires that the tone and messaging be culturally relevant. When observing your competitors, you will understand how to resonate with the local audience as much or better than they do.

Understanding the successes and failures of your competitors will provide the foundation for creating a comprehensive content strategy, thereby allowing you to strategically allocate your resources and to outmaneuver your competitors in the marketplace, and ultimately, to front-load your campaign with successful strategies. Ultimately, by using competitor information to advance your brand, you are developing an educated international SEO strategy based on the strengths and weaknesses of your competitors, and therefore providing a path to achieving your goals.
Wrap Up

Expanding your digital presence across international markets is no small project, but with a proper international SEO strategy and its execution, the rewards far outweigh the challenges. From understanding cultural nuances and conducting multilingual keyword research to implementing proper hreflang tags and analyzing region-specific performance metrics, every element plays a critical role in connecting your brand with global audiences.

Success in international SEO demands a commitment to understanding the unique behaviors, preferences, and expectations of users in each target market. By investing in localized content, leveraging regional influencers, and continuously tracking your performance data, you position your brand to compete effectively on a global scale. Whether you are entering one new market or dozens, a strategic and culturally informed approach to International SEO will ensure that your online presence resonates with audiences worldwide and delivers measurable, long-term results.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
1. What is International SEO, and how does it differ from regular SEO?

International SEO is the process of optimizing your website so that search engines can identify which countries and languages your content is designed to reach. Unlike regular SEO, which typically focuses on ranking within a single market, International SEO requires adapting your strategy to account for cultural differences, multilingual keyword research, regional search engine algorithms, and the unique browsing behaviors of users across different countries and regions.
2. Why are hreflang tags important for my international website?

Hreflang tags tell search engines which language and regional version of a page to serve to each user. Without properly implemented hreflang tags, search engines may display the wrong version of your content to international visitors, resulting in a poor user experience, reduced traffic, and potential duplicate content penalties. Maintaining accurate hreflang tags is essential as your website's content evolves over time.
3. How do I choose the right domain structure for targeting international markets?

The right domain structure depends on your business objectives and the markets you intend to serve. Country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs) send clear geotargeting signals but can dilute domain authority. Subdomains offer easier management, while sub-directories help maintain authority across a single domain. Consulting with an experienced SEO professional can help you determine which approach aligns best with your specific goals and available resources.
4. Why is direct translation not sufficient for international content?

Direct translation fails to account for the cultural context, regional dialects, local slang, and search behaviors that vary from one market to another. Effective International SEO requires localization - adapting your content so that the tone, messaging, and keywords resonate authentically with local audiences. Utilizing native speakers in each target locale ensures that your content feels natural and culturally relevant, rather than generic or out of place.
5. How can I measure the success of my International SEO efforts?

Success should be measured using region-specific metrics rather than broad, global data. Track performance across individual markets by analyzing local search rankings, organic traffic by region, engagement rates, and conversion data. It is also important to account for the dominant search engines in each market (such as Baidu in China or Yandex in Russia) and to continuously adapt your strategy based on evolving search patterns and algorithm updates.

en.description: Affinda is a leading provider of AI-powered document parsing and data extraction solutions. Their advanced technology enables businesses to automate the extraction of critical data from various documents, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. The company's flagship product, the resume parser, helps organizations streamline their recruitment processes by accurately extracting information from resumes.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to achieve top rankings for the keyword "resume parser" on Google to increase visibility and attract more customers.
Affinda faced strong competition from established players in the document parsing industry, making it difficult to secure top rankings.
The market for resume parsers is highly competitive, with numerous companies vying for the same keywords.
Affinda needed an effective SEO strategy that could deliver results within a limited budget.
To overcome these challenges, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Comprehensive SEO Audit
Conducted a thorough audit of Affinda's website to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, and backlink opportunities.

2. Keyword Optimization
Focused on optimizing on-page elements, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and content, for the keyword "resume parser".

3. High-Quality Content Creation
Developed in-depth, high-quality content around the keyword "resume parser" to establish Affinda as an authority in the field.

4. Link Building
Implemented a targeted link-building campaign to acquire high-quality backlinks from relevant, authoritative websites in the AI, technology, and recruitment industries.
5. Key Link Building Postulates

• Publish content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit focused on AI, technology, and recruitment.

  • Ensure publications are on websites with at least two of three criteria: Domain Rating (DR) 50+, Organic Traffic 1000+ with relevant traffic, and reputable TLDs.

  • Maintain a consistent link velocity to match the growth of competitors.

  • Keep all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: With a clear strategy in place, the execution involved:

nodes.value: Enhanced existing content and created new content targeting the keyword "resume parser."
Conducted targeted outreach to secure backlinks from high-authority sites, leveraging relationships with industry influencers and publications.
Fixed identified technical issues, such as site speed, mobile usability, and structured data, to improve overall site performance and search engine visibility.

en.results_description: The combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: Achieved the top position on Google for the keyword "resume parser," surpassing established competitors. This success was validated by the Ahrefs data showing Affinda ranking #1.
Substantial increase in organic traffic, from approximately 11,000 visitors to 28,000 visitors, representing a 2.5x growth.
Increased the number of high-quality referring domains significantly over the campaign period - from 39 referring domains in March 2023 to 142 in July 2023.
Maintained high-quality backlinks, which remained active and continued to provide SEO benefits. We built high-quality links from reputable sites, including Upwork, Entrepreneur, and HubSpot.
Achieved significant growth in Domain Rating from 39 to 48 indicating improved site authority and visibility.

nodes.value: By implementing a comprehensive SEO strategy including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content marketing, we helped My Baskets achieve significant growth in organic traffic and sales.

en.description: My Baskets is a leading Canadian online retailer specializing in luxury gift baskets for various occasions. The website offers a wide range of themed baskets, including gourmet food, wine, baby gifts, and corporate gifts, ensuring a premium gifting experience for every customer.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to regain top rankings for major keywords like "gift baskets Toronto," "gift baskets Canada," and "gourmet gift baskets Canada," after noticing a significant drop in positions due to increased competition.
My Baskets had stable positions at 2 and 3 for major keywords but dropped below position 20 by spring 2023.
Competitors aggressively built new links, and previous link-building efforts were ineffective due to poor quality and relevance.
The budget limited the ability to match competitors' link output, necessitating a strategic approach.
To address these challenges within the budget constraints, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Anchor Text Audit and Optimization
Conducted a thorough audit of internal and external anchor text portfolios to align with targeted anchor text distribution for the homepage and internal collection pages.

• Important Note
    Ensuring the proper distribution of anchor text is crucial for achieving optimal SEO results to supplement low budget off site SEO campaigns.
       a. For the homepage, the target distribution was approximately 5% exact match anchors, 10% partial match and related anchors, and 85% branded and generic anchors,
       b. For internal collection pages, the target was 10% exact match anchors, 50% partial match and related anchors, and 40% branded and generic anchors,

2. Internal and External Link Building
Combined internal and external link-building efforts to achieve the desired anchor text ratio.

3. Topically Relevant Publications
Focused on publishing content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit in lifestyle, parenting, and relationships.

4. Quality Standards
Ensured publications were on websites with a Domain Rating of 50+, organic traffic of 1000+ with Canadian traffic in the top three, and preferably a .CA ccTLD.

5. Link Velocity Management
Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

6. Content Tweaks for Internal Links
Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

7. Content Tweaks for External Links
Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

8. Long-Term External Links
Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: Due to budget limitations, the team focused on:

nodes.value: Utilized Screaming Frog, Ahrefs anchor text report, and in- house Python scripts to audit and flag anchor types, revealing over optimization with 35% exact match anchors.
Created a dynamic spreadsheet with array formulas to track anchor text distribution, internal link opportunities and their implementation progress.
The client's in-house team implemented internal links following the strategy, syncing efforts with our team using the spreadsheet.
Built five high-quality backlinks per month while the client's team added up to 30 internal links to maintain the ratio.
We implemented our own Python scripts to run automated health checks for each link built on a weekly basis in order to ensure it’s longevity for over 11 months.

en.results_description: Despite competitors' higher link output, the combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 2 by October 2023, surpassing bloomex.ca and baskits.com.
From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, outranking bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.
From fluctuating and disappearing from the top 20 in summer 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, competing strongly with bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.

results_cards.title: Googlebot in refresh mode visits have become more frequent and stable

Due to external link daisy chaining we’ve managed to keep new backlink indexation to above 80% within its first month of publishing, whereas it’s a common industry standard for it to be ~60% within the first three months of publishing

Due to automated backlink health checks with our internal Python scripts, we’ve never lost a single link for more than 48 hours keeping it within the index at all times. Our total link loss for this client was less than 0.5% within 11 months, whereas industry standard can be anywhere between 35%-60% within first six month of their publication.

By maintaining quality standards and consistent link velocity growth, we improved the referring domain average DR distribution, keeping an edge over competitors.

What can you do today to help your business grow? How can you stay competitive? Can you improve your processes and efficiency? If you are asking yourself these questions it’s time to consider custom business software. A solution made only for you and with you in mind.

Sounds great, but is it really worth it? Data shows that by next year, the custom software development industry will generate $507.2 billion in revenue. This means custom software development is on the rise.

If this number is not enough to convince you, we have prepared 10 key benefits of custom software that you can’t afford to miss. Let’s start!
What is Custom Business Software?

Custom business software is a customized software solution built for a specific business. It is developed to address unique requests and demands that are uncommon and connected to a single business, niche, or industry.

Unlike most generic solutions, custom solutions are not a one-size-fits-all kind of product. This means that these tailored software solutions are built to fit a current system and business processes that need improving. Because of their personalized approach, custom business software solutions are not only what the business needs but also what it can grow with.

They work great for small businesses as well as enterprise-level companies so your business size or business goals won’t be in the way. What makes them so great is that they are easy to advertise and package as products for other similar businesses. To fully realize your project’s potential, partnering with a reliable custom software development company is essential like “brigit.dev”.
Examples of Custom Software Solutions

• Docebo: E-learning platform for businesses

  • TraceLink: Supply chain management for pharmaceuticals

  • Kareo: Medical practice management software

  • PastPerfect: Museum management software

  • Envirosuite: Environmental monitoring software
Custom Business Software vs Off-the-Shelf Software

image.alt_text: Custom Business Software vs Off-the-Shelf Software
image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401e9f1ebcf9aac6941d04/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png

en.value:
Custom business software and off-the-shelf solutions are different at their core. Custom software is designed for a particular business, while off-the-shelf solutions are intended for a broad range of users. While your business can benefit from both, only custom software solutions can help your business grow. Custom software

Here are the differences that show why:

1. Custom software

    • personalized approach

    • adaptable

    • not available to everyone

    • easy to scale and add new features

  2. Off-the-shelf software

    • built for a mass audience

    • can't be adapted or changed

    • immediately available

    • little or no room for scalability
To show you how these differences translate into real benefits, here's a list of key advantages custom software development can bring you.
10 Key Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth
1. Personalization for your unique needs

Custom software is designed to fit your specific needs. It addresses your unique processes and workflows. It also makes sure that the software works just the way you need it to. This means you get features that directly support your business and improve efficiency and effective use.
2. Higher return on investment

Custom software provides a higher return on investment over time. Because it’s custom-built according to you it can save money in the long run. It helps avoid extra costs associated with adapting off-the-shelf solutions to fit your business.

Additionally, it improves your work and speeds up your progress. It also makes you one step ahead of everyone on the market, because you need very detailed and specific industry expertise to make it. This makes you an industry leader and you can profit from this knowledge.
3. Competitive advantage

Custom software gives you a competitive edge because it keeps you ahead of the game. Your competition probably isn’t investing in solutions like these. They don’t have the time, money, or the expertise to do it. Everyone wants a quick solution. This helps you become a leading name. You can then profit from this down the line and sell your solution to others. It will be easier to market and position yourself as an authority on this matter.
4. Easier scalability

Custom software can grow with your business. As your needs change or expand, the software can be adjusted to handle new challenges. This makes it easier to scale your operations without having to switch to a different system. This is one of the biggest benefits.
5. Increased security

Custom software can provide better security because it is built specifically for your business. It can for example include advanced security features tailored to your unique requirements. This helps protect your sensitive data from potential threats and breaches. With custom solutions security is guaranteed.
6. Selling and marketing potential

Custom software boosts your selling and marketing potential by offering a unique solution to specific market needs. This makes your product stand out and allows you to market it as a specialized tool with features not found in generic software. This easily sets you apart from competitors. It also gives you an even bigger return on the investment down the road.
7. Faster processes

With custom software, you can speed up your business processes. The software is made to match your specific workflow and help with performance optimization. It eliminates unnecessary steps and reduces time spent on tasks. This means your team can work more quickly and productively. Ultimately it leads to faster completion of projects and services.
8. Reliable support and maintenance

Custom software usually comes with reliable support and maintenance. Since the software is built specifically for your business, you can work closely with the development team to address any issues or updates. This ensures that the software remains up-to-date and functions smoothly. It also minimizes downtime and disruptions.
9. Seamless integration

Custom software can be easily integrated with your existing systems, including legacy systems, to improve overall efficiency. It is designed to work seamlessly with other tools and applications you use to reduce compatibility issues. Easy integration doesn’t affect your workflow and avoids the complications of using incompatible software.
10. Longevity

Custom software can have a longer lifespan compared to off-the-shelf solutions. It can be updated and modified as your business grows and changes, extending its usefulness. This long-term adaptability means you won’t need to replace the software very often. It saves time and money in the long run.
Main Disadvantages of Custom Software Development You Should Consider

Custom solutions come with many benefits that most definitely outweigh the possible drawbacks. However, it’s important to know these three disadvantages to prepare and use the full potential of custom software development.
1. Time to deliver

image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 02.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 02.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401f591ebcf9aac6941d05/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 02.png

en.value:
Custom software development often takes longer to make compared to ready-made solutions. Because the software is built specifically for your needs, the process involves detailed planning, design, and multiple stages of development.

Each phase requires a lot of attention to make sure that the software meets all requirements. This extended development period can seem long and tiring. But you must be prepared to wait and know that in the end, your business will benefit greatly from it.

Also, choosing the right custom software development partner can make the development process quicker and better.
2. Onboarding difficulties

image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 03.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 03.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401f8f1ebcf9aac6941d06/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 03.png

en.value:
Even though these solutions are custom-made, some struggle to adapt to them. Unlike off-the-shelf solutions, custom software may have a longer adjustment period.

You may need specialized training to learn how to use it. This is especially true if you are used to general solutions. It might be hard to switch or believe that a single solution can change so much. It’s often all in the mindset.
3. Initial costs

image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 04.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 04.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401fb11ebcf9aac6941d07/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 04.png

en.value:
We don’t want to scare you, but we won’t hide this fact from you. The initial costs of custom software development can be quite high. Building software from scratch involves a lot of expenses for design, development, and testing. We know that this might be a barrier for many. Although the price is not always that high.

Custom software development for small businesses is a lot smaller than for custom enterprise software development. Also, it’s important to note that the long-term benefits outweigh the initial costs and bring a high return on investment.
The Bottom Line

Custom software development comes with many advantages. While the initial investment and longer development time might seem challenging, the benefits outweigh these concerns in the long run.

It is a strategic investment that brings business growth. By focusing on your specific needs, it contributes to the long-term success of your business. So if you want to stay relevant and grow your business in 2026 custom software development is necessary.

en.title: Affinda

seo.title: Affinda SEO Case Study | Boosting "Resume Parser" Rankings
seo.description: Discover how Heroic Rankings helped Affinda dominate search results for "resume parser" with a strategic link-building campaign that improved rankings and organic visibility.

en.service_featured_title: Boosted organic search traffic by 300% and improved lead generation by 120% in 6 months.

nodes.value: Our targeted SEO strategy focused on content optimization, keyword research, and technical improvements led to substantial increases in organic search traffic and lead generation for Affinda.

en.description: Affinda is a leading provider of AI-powered document parsing and data extraction solutions. Their advanced technology enables businesses to automate the extraction of critical data from various documents, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. The company's flagship product, the resume parser, helps organizations streamline their recruitment processes by accurately extracting information from resumes.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to achieve top rankings for the keyword "resume parser" on Google to increase visibility and attract more customers.
Affinda faced strong competition from established players in the document parsing industry, making it difficult to secure top rankings.
The market for resume parsers is highly competitive, with numerous companies vying for the same keywords.
Affinda needed an effective SEO strategy that could deliver results within a limited budget.
To overcome these challenges, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Comprehensive SEO Audit
Conducted a thorough audit of Affinda's website to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, and backlink opportunities.

2. Keyword Optimization
Focused on optimizing on-page elements, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and content, for the keyword "resume parser".

3. High-Quality Content Creation
Developed in-depth, high-quality content around the keyword "resume parser" to establish Affinda as an authority in the field.

4. Link Building
Implemented a targeted link-building campaign to acquire high-quality backlinks from relevant, authoritative websites in the AI, technology, and recruitment industries.
5. Key Link Building Postulates

• Publish content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit focused on AI, technology, and recruitment.

  • Ensure publications are on websites with at least two of three criteria: Domain Rating (DR) 50+, Organic Traffic 1000+ with relevant traffic, and reputable TLDs.

  • Maintain a consistent link velocity to match the growth of competitors.

  • Keep all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: With a clear strategy in place, the execution involved:

nodes.value: Enhanced existing content and created new content targeting the keyword "resume parser."
Conducted targeted outreach to secure backlinks from high-authority sites, leveraging relationships with industry influencers and publications.
Fixed identified technical issues, such as site speed, mobile usability, and structured data, to improve overall site performance and search engine visibility.

en.results_description: The combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: Achieved the top position on Google for the keyword "resume parser," surpassing established competitors. This success was validated by the Ahrefs data showing Affinda ranking #1.
Substantial increase in organic traffic, from approximately 11,000 visitors to 28,000 visitors, representing a 2.5x growth.
Increased the number of high-quality referring domains significantly over the campaign period - from 39 referring domains in March 2023 to 142 in July 2023.
Maintained high-quality backlinks, which remained active and continued to provide SEO benefits. We built high-quality links from reputable sites, including Upwork, Entrepreneur, and HubSpot.
Achieved significant growth in Domain Rating from 39 to 48 indicating improved site authority and visibility.

conclusion_content.title: All external links built by our team remain active, ensuring that our clients continue to benefit from their investments.

nodes.value: This project exemplifies how precise, strategic actions and full collaboration between the client’s team and our in-house experts can achieve outstanding results, even without the initially anticipated budget, by adhering to best practices rather than outspending the competition.

By following this structured approach, Affinda successfully achieved top rankings for the critical keyword "resume parser," demonstrating the effectiveness of strategic link-building and SEO optimization.

en.title: My Baskets

seo.title: My Baskets SEO Success | How Link Building Increased Traffic
seo.description: Learn how Heroic Rankings elevated My Baskets' organic traffic through strategic outreach and high-authority backlinks, strengthening their position in the online gift industry.

en.service_featured_title: Increased organic traffic by 200% and sales by 150% in 12 months.

nodes.value: By implementing a comprehensive SEO strategy including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content marketing, we helped My Baskets achieve significant growth in organic traffic and sales.

en.description: My Baskets is a leading Canadian online retailer specializing in luxury gift baskets for various occasions. The website offers a wide range of themed baskets, including gourmet food, wine, baby gifts, and corporate gifts, ensuring a premium gifting experience for every customer.

nodes.value: The primary goal was to regain top rankings for major keywords like "gift baskets Toronto," "gift baskets Canada," and "gourmet gift baskets Canada," after noticing a significant drop in positions due to increased competition.
My Baskets had stable positions at 2 and 3 for major keywords but dropped below position 20 by spring 2023.
Competitors aggressively built new links, and previous link-building efforts were ineffective due to poor quality and relevance.
The budget limited the ability to match competitors' link output, necessitating a strategic approach.
To address these challenges within the budget constraints, the following strategies were implemented:

1. Anchor Text Audit and Optimization
Conducted a thorough audit of internal and external anchor text portfolios to align with targeted anchor text distribution for the homepage and internal collection pages.

• Important Note
    Ensuring the proper distribution of anchor text is crucial for achieving optimal SEO results to supplement low budget off site SEO campaigns.
       a. For the homepage, the target distribution was approximately 5% exact match anchors, 10% partial match and related anchors, and 85% branded and generic anchors,
       b. For internal collection pages, the target was 10% exact match anchors, 50% partial match and related anchors, and 40% branded and generic anchors,

2. Internal and External Link Building
Combined internal and external link-building efforts to achieve the desired anchor text ratio.

3. Topically Relevant Publications
Focused on publishing content on topically relevant websites with a contextual fit in lifestyle, parenting, and relationships.

4. Quality Standards
Ensured publications were on websites with a Domain Rating of 50+, organic traffic of 1000+ with Canadian traffic in the top three, and preferably a .CA ccTLD.

5. Link Velocity Management
Used daisy chaining to boost indexation time and matched link growth percentage rather than the exact number of links.

6. Content Tweaks for Internal Links
Enhanced internal links by tweaking content within the <main> element to include new sentences, paragraphs, or sections.

7. Content Tweaks for External Links
Maintained a 6:1 ratio of internal to external links to encourage frequent Googlebot visits in Refresh mode.

8. Long-Term External Links
Kept all external links live for at least 11 months after publication.

en.execution_description: Due to budget limitations, the team focused on:

nodes.value: Utilized Screaming Frog, Ahrefs anchor text report, and in- house Python scripts to audit and flag anchor types, revealing over optimization with 35% exact match anchors.
Created a dynamic spreadsheet with array formulas to track anchor text distribution, internal link opportunities and their implementation progress.
The client's in-house team implemented internal links following the strategy, syncing efforts with our team using the spreadsheet.
Built five high-quality backlinks per month while the client's team added up to 30 internal links to maintain the ratio.
We implemented our own Python scripts to run automated health checks for each link built on a weekly basis in order to ensure it’s longevity for over 11 months.

en.results_description: Despite competitors' higher link output, the combined efforts led to significant improvements:

nodes.value: From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 2 by October 2023, surpassing bloomex.ca and baskits.com.
From outside the top 20 in June 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, outranking bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.
From fluctuating and disappearing from the top 20 in summer 2023 to position 1 by October 2023, competing strongly with bloomex.ca, baskits.com, and costco.ca.

results_cards.title: Googlebot in refresh mode visits have become more frequent and stable

Due to external link daisy chaining we’ve managed to keep new backlink indexation to above 80% within its first month of publishing, whereas it’s a common industry standard for it to be ~60% within the first three months of publishing

Due to automated backlink health checks with our internal Python scripts, we’ve never lost a single link for more than 48 hours keeping it within the index at all times. Our total link loss for this client was less than 0.5% within 11 months, whereas industry standard can be anywhere between 35%-60% within first six month of their publication.

nodes.value: Anchor text distribution optimization played a crucial role when external link building was limited.
By maintaining quality standards and consistent link velocity growth, we improved the referring domain average DR distribution, keeping an edge over competitors.

conclusion_content.title: By following this structured approach, My Baskets successfully regained top positions for critical keywords, demonstrating the effectiveness of strategic link- building and anchor text optimization.

nodes.value: All external links built by our team remain active, ensuring that our clients continue to benefit from their investments.

This project exemplifies how precise, strategic actions and full collaboration between the client’s team and our in-house experts can achieve outstanding results, even without the initially anticipated budget, by adhering to best practices rather than outspending the competition.

en.description: DesignRush is a B2B marketplace that connects businesses with top professional agencies in fields such as web design, digital marketing, branding, and technology. nodes.value: The primary goal was to build high-quality backlinks to improve SEO and compete effectively with Clutch.co, particularly in the categories of Web Design Companies and Digital Marketing Agencies.
DesignRush had a strong in-house SEO team covering strategy, content, and development but relied heavily on PRs and reciprocal backlinks, which were of lower quality and less effective.
Reciprocal links, often from lower-quality sites, had limited SEO impact. The competition, particularly Clutch.co, had a significantly larger volume of high-quality backlinks.
Initial link-building efforts by external agencies couldn't scale due to high costs and inconsistent quality.

Established clear SOPs and quality guidelines for link building.

Assisted in the recruitment and hiring process for new link builders.

Aligned work, goals, and KPIs with the SEO and content departments.

Developed reporting structures for shareholders, the head of marketing, and finance departments.

  2. Publish only on websites that meet at least two of three criteria: Domain Rating (DR) 50+, Organic Traffic 1000+ with US traffic in the top three, and gTLDs or ccTLDs of English-speaking countries.

  3. Daisy chain external links to boost indexation time and match link velocity percentage growth rather than exact link numbers.

What can you do today to help your business grow? How can you stay competitive? Can you improve your processes and efficiency? If you are asking yourself these questions it’s time to consider custom business software. A solution made only for you and with you in mind.

Sounds great, but is it really worth it? Data shows that by next year, the custom software development industry will generate $507.2 billion in revenue. This means custom software development is on the rise.

If this number is not enough to convince you, we have prepared 10 key benefits of custom software that you can’t afford to miss. Let’s start!
What is Custom Business Software?

Custom business software is a customized software solution built for a specific business. It is developed to address unique requests and demands that are uncommon and connected to a single business, niche, or industry.

Unlike most generic solutions, custom solutions are not a one-size-fits-all kind of product. This means that these tailored software solutions are built to fit a current system and business processes that need improving. Because of their personalized approach, custom business software solutions are not only what the business needs but also what it can grow with.

They work great for small businesses as well as enterprise-level companies so your business size or business goals won’t be in the way. What makes them so great is that they are easy to advertise and package as products for other similar businesses. To fully realize your project’s potential, partnering with a reliable custom software development company is essential like “brigit.dev”.
Examples of Custom Software Solutions

• Docebo: E-learning platform for businesses

  • TraceLink: Supply chain management for pharmaceuticals

  • Kareo: Medical practice management software

  • PastPerfect: Museum management software

  • Envirosuite: Environmental monitoring software
Custom Business Software vs Off-the-Shelf Software

image.alt_text: Custom Business Software vs Off-the-Shelf Software
image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401e9f1ebcf9aac6941d04/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 01.png

en.value:
Custom business software and off-the-shelf solutions are different at their core. Custom software is designed for a particular business, while off-the-shelf solutions are intended for a broad range of users. While your business can benefit from both, only custom software solutions can help your business grow. Custom software

Here are the differences that show why:

1. Custom software

    • personalized approach

    • adaptable

    • not available to everyone

    • easy to scale and add new features

  2. Off-the-shelf software

    • built for a mass audience

    • can't be adapted or changed

    • immediately available

    • little or no room for scalability
To show you how these differences translate into real benefits, here's a list of key advantages custom software development can bring you.
10 Key Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth
1. Personalization for your unique needs

Custom software is designed to fit your specific needs. It addresses your unique processes and workflows. It also makes sure that the software works just the way you need it to. This means you get features that directly support your business and improve efficiency and effective use.
2. Higher return on investment

Custom software provides a higher return on investment over time. Because it’s custom-built according to you it can save money in the long run. It helps avoid extra costs associated with adapting off-the-shelf solutions to fit your business.

Additionally, it improves your work and speeds up your progress. It also makes you one step ahead of everyone on the market, because you need very detailed and specific industry expertise to make it. This makes you an industry leader and you can profit from this knowledge.
3. Competitive advantage

Custom software gives you a competitive edge because it keeps you ahead of the game. Your competition probably isn’t investing in solutions like these. They don’t have the time, money, or the expertise to do it. Everyone wants a quick solution. This helps you become a leading name. You can then profit from this down the line and sell your solution to others. It will be easier to market and position yourself as an authority on this matter.
4. Easier scalability

Custom software can grow with your business. As your needs change or expand, the software can be adjusted to handle new challenges. This makes it easier to scale your operations without having to switch to a different system. This is one of the biggest benefits.
5. Increased security

Custom software can provide better security because it is built specifically for your business. It can for example include advanced security features tailored to your unique requirements. This helps protect your sensitive data from potential threats and breaches. With custom solutions security is guaranteed.
6. Selling and marketing potential

Custom software boosts your selling and marketing potential by offering a unique solution to specific market needs. This makes your product stand out and allows you to market it as a specialized tool with features not found in generic software. This easily sets you apart from competitors. It also gives you an even bigger return on the investment down the road.
7. Faster processes

With custom software, you can speed up your business processes. The software is made to match your specific workflow and help with performance optimization. It eliminates unnecessary steps and reduces time spent on tasks. This means your team can work more quickly and productively. Ultimately it leads to faster completion of projects and services.
8. Reliable support and maintenance

Custom software usually comes with reliable support and maintenance. Since the software is built specifically for your business, you can work closely with the development team to address any issues or updates. This ensures that the software remains up-to-date and functions smoothly. It also minimizes downtime and disruptions.
9. Seamless integration

Custom software can be easily integrated with your existing systems, including legacy systems, to improve overall efficiency. It is designed to work seamlessly with other tools and applications you use to reduce compatibility issues. Easy integration doesn’t affect your workflow and avoids the complications of using incompatible software.
10. Longevity

Custom software can have a longer lifespan compared to off-the-shelf solutions. It can be updated and modified as your business grows and changes, extending its usefulness. This long-term adaptability means you won’t need to replace the software very often. It saves time and money in the long run.
Main Disadvantages of Custom Software Development You Should Consider

Custom solutions come with many benefits that most definitely outweigh the possible drawbacks. However, it’s important to know these three disadvantages to prepare and use the full potential of custom software development.
1. Time to deliver

image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 02.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 02.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401f591ebcf9aac6941d05/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 02.png

en.value:
Custom software development often takes longer to make compared to ready-made solutions. Because the software is built specifically for your needs, the process involves detailed planning, design, and multiple stages of development.

Each phase requires a lot of attention to make sure that the software meets all requirements. This extended development period can seem long and tiring. But you must be prepared to wait and know that in the end, your business will benefit greatly from it.

Also, choosing the right custom software development partner can make the development process quicker and better.
2. Onboarding difficulties

image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 03.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 03.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401f8f1ebcf9aac6941d06/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 03.png

en.value:
Even though these solutions are custom-made, some struggle to adapt to them. Unlike off-the-shelf solutions, custom software may have a longer adjustment period.

You may need specialized training to learn how to use it. This is especially true if you are used to general solutions. It might be hard to switch or believe that a single solution can change so much. It’s often all in the mindset.
3. Initial costs

image.name: The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 04.png
image.src: /The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 04.png
image.url: https://app.thebcms.com/api/v3/instance/6710e3bdeeda0c4a2de4b330/media/68401fb11ebcf9aac6941d07/bin2/The Benefits of Custom Business Software for Business Growth - Image 04.png

en.value:
We don’t want to scare you, but we won’t hide this fact from you. The initial costs of custom software development can be quite high. Building software from scratch involves a lot of expenses for design, development, and testing. We know that this might be a barrier for many. Although the price is not always that high.

Custom software development for small businesses is a lot smaller than for custom enterprise software development. Also, it’s important to note that the long-term benefits outweigh the initial costs and bring a high return on investment.
The Bottom Line

Custom software development comes with many advantages. While the initial investment and longer development time might seem challenging, the benefits outweigh these concerns in the long run.

It is a strategic investment that brings business growth. By focusing on your specific needs, it contributes to the long-term success of your business. So if you want to stay relevant and grow your business in 2026 custom software development is necessary.
